signature: DOUBLE PRECISION FUNCTION ZLANTB( NORM, UPLO, DIAG, N, K, AB,

params.name: norm
params.reference: Specifies the value to be returned in ZLANTB as described above.

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
Specifies whether the matrix A is upper or lower triangular.

-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangular
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangular

params.name: diag
params.reference:
Specifies whether or not the matrix A is unit triangular.

-   `= 'N'`: Non-unit triangular
-   `= 'U'`: Unit triangular

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$. When $N = 0$, ZLANTB is set to zero.

params.name: K
params.reference: The number of super-diagonals of the matrix A if `UPLO = 'U'`, or the number of sub-diagonals of the matrix A if `UPLO = 'L'`. $K \ge 0$.

params.name: AB
params.reference: The upper or lower triangular band matrix A, stored in the first k+1 rows of `AB`. The j-th column of A is stored in the j-th column of the array `AB` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AB(k+1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $\max (1,j-k) \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AB(1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le \min (n,j+k)$. Note that when `DIAG = 'U'`, the elements of the array `AB` corresponding to the diagonal elements of the matrix A are not referenced, but are assumed to be one.

params.name: ldab
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `AB`. $\mathrm{LDAB} \ge K+1$.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: where $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge N$ when `NORM = 'I'`; otherwise, `WORK` is not referenced.

notes: no derivable minimum length for workspace WORK
